origin.p: Written in Norway, probably in the Bergen area, c. 1270.

DG 4-7 now consists of 42 leaves in seven gatherings, each of originally 8 leaves. Thus, the complete manuscript once had (7 x 8) = 56 leaves. The first gathering lacks the middle pair and another leaf, which has been cut out. The second gathering also lacks the middle pair. The third and fourth gatherings are complete. The fifth gathering lacks the middle pair, and the sixth gathering lacks the fourth leaf, which has been cut out. The seventh gathering only has the outer pair of leaves. Remnants of the seventh gathering were found as the lining of a bishop’s mitra in Skálholt, and are now catalouged as AM 666b 4to in Copenhagen.

At the very beginning of DG 4-7, there are two leaves containing a fragment of "Óláfs saga". In the present state of the manuscript (and in the facsimile edition by Mattias Tveitane, 1972), they are fols. 1–2.

The main part of the manuscript are fols. 3–44, containing the end of "Pamphilus saga", 13 lines of a dialogue between courage and fear, "Elis saga" and finally "Strengleikar". Note that in the facsimile edition and also in the present electronic edition, the leaves have been numbered consecutively in the order they now have in the manuscript, irrespective of lost leaves and leaves which have been put in the wrong order as a result of the later binding of the book.

The present electronic edition begins with the opening of "Strengleikar" at fol. 17vA.6 and contains all the rest of the text in the manuscript, thus ending at fol. 43vB.38. There are two lacunas, one between the present fols. 32v and 33r (making "Tidorel" and "Chetovel" incomplete) and another between the present fols. 38v and 39r (a leaf has been cut out here, removing most of the presumably indecent "Leikara ljóð" and the beginning of "Janual") Finally, "Ricar hinn gamli" breaks off shortly after the beginning, since the 7th gathering is so damaged. The two lais in the remainder of the 7th gathering, "Tveggja elskanda strengleikr" and "Grelent", are preserved in parts in what is now AM 666b 4to.

When the manuscript was bound for Stephanus Johannis Stephanius (1599–1650) in the 17th century, the two inner pairs of leaves in the 4th gathering were shifted round; in the present foliation they are fols. 24, 25, 26 and 27. In this edition, the text is rendered in the sequence it once had, so the leaves will be found in the following order: ... fol. 21, fol. 22, fol. 23, fol. 25, fol. 24, fol. 27, fol. 26, fol. 28, fol. 29, fol. 30 ...
The information compiled here is based on the introduction in the facsimile edition by Mattias Tveitane (1972) and the introduction in the edition by Mattias Tveitane and Robert Cook (1979).

projectDesc.p: This manuscript text has been encoded according to the standard set out in The Menota handbook (version 2.0 beta), at http://www.menota.org/guidelines as of 2007-01-30.
The text has numbered pagebreaks and linebreaks according to Unger’s and Keyser’s edition (referred to as "Unger"), and numbered pagebreaks, columnbreaks and linebreaks according to the manuscript.

correction.p: This text is based on the text in the slip collection of Gammelnorsk Ordboksverk and the text in Unger's and Keyser’s edition and corrected against the manuscript.

normalization.p: This text has been encoded on a diplomatic level.

interpretation.p: The complete text has been lemmatised and morphologically analysed by the Gammelnorsk Ordboksverk and then transformed according to the rules specified in ch. 8 of the Menota Handbook, v. 2.0.

2020-02-24
Odd Einar Haugen University of Bergen : (1) Changed all “mIM” name tokens (for imperative mood) with “mIP”; (2) Changed all “rPgM” name tokens with “rP gM” (adding a space between them)

2016-02-21
Odd Einar Haugen University of Bergen : (1) Revised the "availability" element in the header with a CC-BY-SA 4.0 licence; (2) Made the file v. 1.1.2

2016-01-19
Odd Einar Haugen University of Bergen : (1) Added role="person" as an attribute to the second "editor" element; (2) Made the file v. 1.1.1

2010-10-04 Odd Einar Haugen, University of Bergen: Added one "div" for each of the 20 "lais" in the text; corrected the morphological annotation of words marked as "sjekk" (38 examples) and "ukjent" (4 examples); added the attribute "xml:lang="lat"" in Latin words (45 examples); changed all words marked as "xPD" into either "xPE" (vér, vit, ér), "xPR" (sik), "xPQ" (hvat, hveim), "xPI" (einn, hvetvetna), "xDD" (sá, siá, hinn), "xDQ" (annarr, báðir, einn, einnhverr, engi, fyrstr/fyrsti, hvárgi, hvárr, hvárrtveggi, hvárrtveggja, hvergi, hvílíkr, hverr, jafnmargr, nǫkkurr, margr, plus the cardinal numbers, tveir, þrír, fiórir, etc.) or "xDP" (yðarr), changed all "xNU" to either "xNA" or "xNO" (fiórir and fiórði) (16 examples), changed all "xAT" to "xDQ" (the word einn) (94 examples), changed all remaining "xCU" to "xCS" (the words at, né, ef, sem and hvárt) (971 examples); changed all "xNU" to either "xDQ" (cardinals) or "xAJ" (ordinals); changed several words to "xAQ" (hvar, hvert, hvaðan, hvesu, hví); put one dittographical word into "me:expunged" element (with resp="Odd Einar Haugen") and removed the superfluous sign "°" (117 examples). Removed dummy values ("lemma="xyzzy" me:msa="xyzzy") for words that for some reason had not received annotation (915 examples). Made the file into version 1.1.

2010-09-22 Odd Einar Haugen, University of Bergen: Changed the word class code for the subjunction "er" from "xRP" (relative particle) to "xCS" (subjunction), checked the file and declared it (with some trepidation) version 1.0

2010-09-21 Christian-Emil Ore, University of Oslo: Added line numbers to the "lb" milestones referring to the manuscript, identified words outside "word" elements, changed a number of word class codes, and did some clean-up of the file.

2010-08-30 Odd Einar Haugen, University of Bergen: Moved the last part of the file, containing the four defective leaves from the bishop’s mitra in Skálholt and established a new file, AM 666b 4to, for them, since the entries in the Menota corpus should be organised according to manuscript catalogue numbers. Updated the header in a number of places. Corrected a number of wrong values for pagebreak and columnbreak in the encoding. Changed the element "expan" to "ex", according to TEI P5. Changed all character entities to Unicode characters, e.g. converting "eth" to "ð", so that the text should be more readable; the only exception being "vacute" for which there is no safe rendering. Commented on a number of "w" elements missing attributes, and a smaller number of attribute values tagged as "sjekk". Made it into version 0.9.8.

2008-10-24 Tone Merete Bruvik, Aksis: Introduced Relax NG Schema and did the changes necessary for that transformation. The encoding of extent in gap has been changed, and unit has been supplied. Made the file into version 0.9.7.
2008-01-18 Tone Merete Bruvik: Updated the text to Menota 2.0, which is based on TEI P5 1.0. Made some changes in the header.
2007.06.29 Tone Merete Bruvik: Added namespace reference in the root element, and removed empty persName in the editor element.
2007.06.28 Tone Merete Bruvik: Removed rombe character from the file.
2007.06.25 Odd Einar Haugen: Changed the characters /´æ/ to ǽ and /e,/ to ę.
2007.05.29 Jonas Wellendorf: Added column breaks according to the manuscript, and also linebreak for the first line of each column.
2007.01.30 Christian-Emil Ore: Converted the electronic files (the transcription and the lemmatisation) into XML (Extensible Markup Language) according to the guidelines in the Menota handbook.
